children: Macquarie likes Woodside Energy's new approach to its dividend. Woodside now aims to return 20%-40% of adjusted operating cash flows to shareholders. The company previously sought to return at least 50% of underlying net profit as dividends, with a target payout ratio of 50-80%. Macquarie had been hoping that Woodside would overhaul its dividend policy at its investor day on Thursday, and considers the result to be a significant improvement. "A new cashflow based dividend introduces more predictability and, ultimately, a higher dividend yield (5-7% fully franked)," Macquarie says. It rates Woodside at neutral. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
